newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Training names new president.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Training names new president.

text.p: ITC said Tuesday that Steven Roden has been appointed as president, replacing Philip Facchina, who resigned as president and chief operating officer effective November 30.
Roden spent the past year overseas, successfully launching ITC's international sales efforts, the company said.
Facchina resigned to accept the position of senior vice president of strategic business development for ViewCall America Inc.
ITC said Facchina will continue to serve on the ITC Board and will consult with the company during Roden's transition.
ITC develops workplace training for business, education, and government and is based in Herndon, Va.
